caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “Humour” illustrates the performance of four different prompts (V1, V2, V3, and V4) from the HDM framework in translating humour, as evaluated by the GEMBA-SQM scoring metric. The horizontal axis lists the four prompt variants in order from left to right: V1, V2, V3, and V4. The vertical axis represents the score on a linear scale ranging from 60.0 to 80.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 2.5. Each bar is colored distinctly — V1 is blue (71.4), V2 is orange (68.5), V3 is green (71.9), and V4 is purple (68.15) — and the exact score is labeled above each bar. V3 achieves the highest score at 71.9, followed closely by V1 at 71.4, while V2 and V4 trail with scores of 68.5 and 68.15 respectively. The chart visually emphasizes the relative performance differences among the four variants, with V3 and V1 significantly outperforming V2 and V4 in humour translation quality according to the GEMBA-SQM metric.
